newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gas Natural Q1 net down 4.6 pct to 16.15 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Gas Natural Q1 net down 4.6 pct to 16.15 bln ptas.

text.p: First quarter results for Gas Natural group (in billions of pesetas, unless stated):

NOTE: Gas Natural said first quarter earnings were affected by an exceptionally mild winter and by lower unit margins, both for the domestic and the industrial business, because of a cut in the gas tariff.
Sales to households fell 11 percent to 7.35 billion therms, despite a 200,000 increase in the number of customers year on year.
Sales to industrial clients rose 20 percent to 21.0 billion therms. Other sales, including to electricity firms and other distributors, doubled to 6.0 billion therms.
Overall gas sales grew 18 percent to 35.0 billion therms.
Total customers increased by 51,000 in the first quarter.
Investments totalled over 14 billion pesetas and were mainly aimed at improving the distribution network, the firm said.
